Alphabet Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif. – July 22, 2026  – Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOG, GOOGL) today announced financial 
results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
• Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased  24%, or 23% in constant currency, to $119.8 billion, reflecting 
strong performance across the business and our 12th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth. 
• Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion, led by 17% growth in Google Sea
